prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `posterior(prior, sensitivity, false_positive)` in src/lib.rs for Bayes' theorem. Given `P(A) = prior`, `P(B|A) = sensitivity` and `P(B|not A) = false_positive`, return `P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A) / (P(B|A)P(A) + P(B|not A)P(not A))`. Return `None` when an input is not finite or outside `[0, 1]`, or when the denominator is zero. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
